name: Nivelles Bigs 2025

venue.name: Collège saint Gertrude
venue.details: The venue is the cafeteria of the local secondary school. To access the venue, you have to enter the school by Le Boulevard de la Dodaine, the main gate will be closed.

information:
This competition will not hold the most popular events, newcomers should be aware that there won't be usual events such as 3x3, 2x2 or pyraminx.

This competition is a twin comp with Quiet Nivelles 2025. You can attend only one of these two competitions.
